window.before_phase5_pr: Run assert_exportable(). It supersedes the manual re-verification this field used to describe: it reports per-block drift and refuses to export over anything unacknowledged. The risk it protects against is unchanged — shipping a contribution derived from superseded claims.
window.live_state_policy: Living inputs report DRIFT; they do not assert violation. scope_drift() compares each consumed block against its sealed per-block digest and returns a per-block report. verify_phase2_baseline() treats that drift as information, not error: exports are periodic and the model keeps being corrected, so every past seal would otherwise go red at its own moment, correctly and uselessly, until nobody read the suite. The gate bites at export time only — assert_exportable() refuses a NEW export built on blocks whose drift nobody has resolved. Acknowledgements live in dismech_drift_acknowledgements.jsonl, bind to the exact live digest, and expire the moment the block moves again, because otherwise 'resolved' decays into 'ignored once, ignored forever'. The frozen-blob half of the verifier is unchanged and stays an error: it is content-addressed, immutable, and the only half that does not degrade as the model grows.
window.rationale: The four comparison axes are closed (dismech_axis4_result.md: 'This closes the four axes'). Axis 4 is near-empty for a structural reason, not for want of data: the production dedup key merges two occurrences only when an author wrote the same sentence twice, so a third derivation would reproduce the same one-merge-against-none comparison at any scale. Axis 2 was already confirmed by two blind reviewers and the independent derivation is archived, not staged for reuse. No measurement remains that a further derivation against these inputs would inform.
window.verification_scope: Immutable inputs and the output are verified whole, at git_head_at_freeze and in the working tree. The receipt ledger is verified by append-only prefix. The two canonical registries are verified by the blocks the derivation consumed. Editing a registry outside that scope is not a violation of this freeze; editing inside it is.
window.verifier_exclusion_reason: A verifier sealed by the baseline it checks can never be repaired, only abandoned: every correction to the checker falsifies the seal. Data, derivation scripts and outputs stay sealed; the checker does not. Its integrity is carried by git history and its own test suite.
